Tests call gates through ddflow, no full-suite run.

chunk_findings.detail: Items whose size was never recorded are treated as failing the tiny-cold line limit. `_size_of` returns 0 when every outcome has `changed_lines` missing, and `_size_bucket` says that 0 “says nothing”, but `_tiny_cold` still puts those spans in `total` and only increments `count` when `0 < lines <= tiny_cold_max_source_lines`. Two completed items with no `changed_lines` therefore become `count=0`, `total=2` and, once `min_samples` is met, a 0% rate: “0 of 2 completed items met the source-line limit”. They were not measured, so that zero is a false fail [r-unavailable-not-pass]. The same mix (one 5-line item and one unmeasured item) is reported as 50% instead of 1 of 1 measured.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/metrics/tiny.py:_tiny_cold

chunk_findings.detail: `bundle_savings` is listed under `not_measured`, but the shipped reason states “the saved gate-seconds are zero until the first bundle lands”. That asserts a numeric zero the log does not support. Intent is unavailable-not-zero, and bundling having never been observed is not evidence that savings were zero.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/metrics/tiny.py:NOT_MEASURED

chunk_findings.detail: A missing completion time is coerced to epoch. `at > (s.completed_at or 0)` treats `completed_at` of `None` or `0` as time 0, so any bug timestamp `> 0` on that item is a “later” bug. A completed span with no `completed_at` and a bug filed at t=1 is counted in `later` and raises `later_bug_rate` even though the bug is not known to be after completion.
